text:
```yaml
name: Security Scan

on:
  schedule:
    # Daily scan at 10 AM UTC
    - cron: '0 10 * * *'
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  trivy-security-scan:
    name: Trivy Security Scan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Harden Runner
        uses: step-security/harden-runner@20cf305ff2072d973412fa9b1e3a4f227bda3c76
        with:
          egress-policy: audit

      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Build Docker image
        run: |
          docker build -t opentelemetry-mcp-server .

      - name: Run Trivy vulnerability scanner
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@master
        with:
          image-ref: opentelemetry-mcp-server
          scan-type: "image"
          format: "table"
          exit-code: 1
          ignore-unfixed: true
          severity: "CRITICAL,HIGH"
```
